lastCompletedStory.title: Implement the PR-create and merge-mode step (gh integration)

openQuestions: runShipPhase's runGatesFn/bumpFn/finalizeFn/runShipPrStepFn are all required injected functions with no production factory wired yet (deliberately deferred to US-004): the shipping-phase wiring must build a makeProductionShipPhaseFn in sidecar.ts that composes runShipPhase with real spawnFn/gates/bump/finalize adapters AND a real runShipPrStepFn closure wrapping runShipPrStep (src/release/ship-pr.ts) with production spawnFn (spawnSync-backed, gh mutation calls stripping GITHUB_TOKEN per the pattern already inside ship-pr.ts's own stripGithubToken helper), a real temp-file writer (mkdtempSync+writeFileSync), a real review-artifact reader (existsSync+readFileSync against REVIEW_ARTIFACT_FILENAME from src/supervisor/review-report.ts), readMergeMode/readMergeWatchState/writeMergeWatchState/removeMergeWatchState (merge-watch.ts) resolved against join(cwd,'.claude',MERGE_WATCH_FILENAME), and closeIssueOnMain (issue-specify.ts).

The ShipPhaseResult union no longer has a 'ready-for-pr' kind (replaced by 'shipped' and 'pr-create-failed' in US-003); US-004's shipping branch in loop.ts must switch on all 9 kinds (on-main, prd-incomplete, no-commits-ahead, gates-failed, bump-failed, finalize-failed, push-failed, pr-create-failed, shipped) per its AC3.
nextStoryContext: US-004 (wire the shipping phase into the sidecar loop) consumes runShipPhase (ship-runner.ts) as a black box: it needs a 'shipping' branch in runSidecarLoop (loop.ts) that invokes an injected runShipPhaseFn and reacts to the full ShipPhaseResult union (9 kinds after US-003, see openQuestions above), mirroring the existing planning-branch precedent (outer try/catch + sidecar-exit event + phase precedes the active check). It also needs to swap the auto-mode CLEAN trigger from tmux send-keys '/cam-ship' to setPhase('shipping'). The production wiring (makeProductionShipPhaseFn in sidecar.ts) must compose runShipPhase with real adapters for ALL FOUR required deps: runGatesFn (spawn 'bun run check:all', capture output tail on failure), bumpFn (wraps runShipBump), finalizeFn (wraps finalizeCycleClose), and — new in US-003 — runShipPrStepFn (wraps runShipPrStep from src/release/ship-pr.ts with real spawnFn/writeTempFile/readReviewArtifact/readMergeModeFn/readMergeWatchStateFn/writeMergeWatchStateFn/removeMergeWatchStateFn/closeIssueOnMainFn/emitHint/emitWarning). Reuse the index.ts _buildBumpOpts/_buildFinalizeOpts adapters rather than duplicating (jscpd gate).

officialDocsValidated.summary: --title, --body-file, --base all confirmed current flags with the exact semantics used in ship-pr.ts (--base defaults to the repo default branch when omitted; we always pass --base main explicitly).
--auto and --squash confirmed current; --auto with no positional arg targets the PR of the current branch, matching ship-pr.ts's argv (no PR number passed to gh pr merge).
--json number --jq '.number' confirmed as the documented example for extracting the PR number; matches ship-pr.ts's exact argv.
